summary.failureBoundary: The supported agent interface cannot provide its webmcp capability despite native registrations on the Chrome pages.
summary.rootCause: Unresolved: unsupported connector route, feature gating/rollout, or a connector defect are not distinguished by the observed error.

currentProviderDiagnosis.immediateCause: The current Codex Chrome provider does not advertise the optional webmcp tab capability.

confounds: Both loopback fixtures receive automatic project-extension injection. The first probe confirms page-provided tool registration, not an extension-absent environment.
The fixtures differ in port/origin, schema and page headers. A differential outcome would require a tighter control before causal attribution.
The earlier Chrome record predates project-extension loading and already shows the same missing capability; it is historical evidence, not a fresh no-extension control.
The page-provided registration status is fixture-rendered evidence. The extension descriptor was independently observed through the fixture's public getTools button.

Fresh ordinary browser operations succeeded. No native-host repair, profile-store inspection, blocked manager/flag access, hidden transport, direct CDP, or browser-client implementation inspection was used.
The user later pasted a result from a non-Work context with the same missing capability. It is not an independent ChatGPT Work comparison.
The openai-docs and Chrome/spec reviews establish public interfaces and documented support; documentation silence does not establish universal lack of support.

priorEvidence.finding: Before project-extension loading, Chrome 152 reported three page-provided native registrations; only pageAssets was advertised and the webmcp capability request failed.
Six page-mediated native executions succeeded across the installed runtime; a final same-tab agent capability request still failed.
The same runtime source worked with native agent tools in the separate in-app browser fixture; both runtime halves ran in MAIN, not as an installed MV3 extension.
